title: Requirements a Vehicle Meets before a Keyturn Vehicle Listing Goes Live
content:
A vehicle goes live on a Keyturn Vehicle Listing only where it sits inside its class's value band, age limit, odometer limit and seat range, and where the class accepts how it is titled and where it is registered.

**Age.** Vehicle age is counted in whole years from the model year to the year the listing is reviewed, so a vehicle of the model year exactly at the class limit is still accepted.

**Financed and leased vehicles.** A financed or leased vehicle goes live only where the lender's written consent has been verified on the listing, and the host's statement that their lender permits it is not a substitute for the consent document itself. The clause is settled before the vehicle goes live, on the marketplace's own records — the consent document verified on the vehicle's condition record, read against the title standing on the listing — and the consent is gathered to the vehicle by the listing it was verified against.

**Photographs.** The listing must carry at least the class's minimum photographs, showing the class's required exterior angles and interior views, each at or above the class's minimum resolution; a listing short of any of these goes back to the host rather than live with a note.

**Inspection.** Where the class requires an inspection before listing, the vehicle goes live only where a passed inspection already stands on the vehicle record. That condition too is settled before the vehicle goes live and on the record rather than on the host's account of it: the standing of the listing, which at that point is a listing under review or one already live, and the date of the inspection standing on the vehicle, both gathered to the vehicle by the listing.

**Review.** Review takes the class's review period in business days counted from the day the listing was submitted, and a listing whose registration expires during the review is not published until the registration is renewed.

**Activation fee.** The activation fee, where the class charges one, falls due when the listing goes live and not when it is submitted, so a listing that never passes review is never charged for.

### Two readings at the age boundary

A class whose limit is 12 whole years, a listing reviewed in 2026: a vehicle of model year 2014 is 12 whole years old and is accepted, the limit being a figure the class accepts at. A vehicle of model year 2013 is 13 whole years old and is not accepted.
